items.t: No clear trend in pollution-sensitive animals in this region (+0.5 points per decade; 4,824 surveys at 666 sites, 2002–2026; q = 0.054). The overall survey score, though, is rising (q = 0.015).
Chloride: of 128 sites with long records here, 21 are rising and 4 falling (seasonal Kendall per site, false discovery rate 5% across all 396 sites tested).
Paved and roofed area went from 3.9% in 1985 to 5.4% in 2025 across 2,619 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work (area-weighted).

556 of 2,619 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have water the state lists as impaired for aquatic life, 145 for salt or chloride; 952 have a discharge permit holder in significant noncompliance.
146 of 2,619 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have a volunteer bug site surveyed since 2021; 264 of 302 high-need ones have none.

What best predicts the sensitive share in this region: developed land (lower share where it is higher), paved and roofed area (lower share where it is higher; top three in 4 of 5 repeats), forest (higher share where it is higher; top three in 3 of 5 repeats). The model explains 39% of the variation at sites it never saw (range 37–41% over 5 repeats; 4,824 surveys at 666 sites).
